_note: Source of truth for the Shopify catalogue (PRD-01 §3). The seed script reads this and upserts by handle, so it is idempotent and re-runnable against any store (PRD-01 §10). TWO-TIER MODEL: furniture does not replenish, so `replenishment_days` carries a different meaning per tier and `role` names which one applies. Tier 1 (role=anchor|companion) — the number is an ATTACH WINDOW: the typical days after this piece lands before the next piece of the same room follows. An anchor opens a room project; companions complete it. Tier 2 (role=accent|care) — the number is a GENUINE repurchase cycle, the same meaning it had for consumables: cushion covers, throws, vases, polish and fabric guard really do get rebought. §F3.4 predicts next-order-date from this number in both tiers; what differs is what the prediction means (a cross-sell window closing vs. a refill coming due).

products.title: Aravalli Sofa
products.description: A low-slung three-seater on a solid sheesham frame, with feather-blend cushions that hold their shape past the first year. Deep enough to actually sit back in. Most rooms are built outward from this piece, which is why the coffee table and rug usually follow within six weeks.
products.materials: Kiln-dried sheesham frame, high-resilience foam with feather-blend topper, handwoven cotton-linen upholstery, solid teak legs with a natural oil finish.

products.title: Kota Stone Coffee Table
products.description: Honed Kota stone on a slim powder-coated base. The stone is cool to the touch and takes a ring mark far less readily than marble, which matters in a room where people actually put cups down.
products.materials: Honed Kota limestone top, powder-coated mild steel base, felt-tipped levelling feet.

products.title: Jaipur Dhurrie Rug
products.description: Flatwoven in Jaipur on a pit loom, in undyed cotton with a natural-dye border. Reversible, so it takes a decade of foot traffic. Buy it after the sofa, not before — the sofa decides the size.
products.materials: Handloomed cotton warp and weft, natural vegetable dyes, cotton-tape bound edges.

products.title: Brass Arc Floor Lamp
products.description: An unlacquered brass arc that reaches over a sofa without a side table underneath it. The brass is left raw on purpose and will patina unevenly where hands touch it.
products.materials: Unlacquered solid brass stem, cast-iron weighted base, cotton-wrapped braided cord, E27 fitting.

products.title: Sheesham Platform Bed
products.description: A low platform bed in solid sheesham with a slatted base and no box spring required. Joinery is mortise-and-tenon, so it can be taken apart and moved without losing its rigidity.
products.materials: Solid Indian rosewood (sheesham), mortise-and-tenon joinery, kiln-dried pine slats, matte polyurethane finish.

products.title: Mysore Teak Wardrobe
products.description: Full-height teak wardrobe with soft-close hinges and a cedar-lined lower drawer. Interior is fitted rather than a single hanging rail, so it holds a real wardrobe rather than a showroom one.
products.materials: Solid Mysore teak carcass and doors, cedar-lined drawer, soft-close European hinges, brass pulls.

products.title: Cane Weave Bedside Table
products.description: A single-drawer bedside table with a hand-caned front panel. Sized to sit level with a low platform bed rather than towering over it. Usually bought as a pair, which is why the pair is priced as one.
products.materials: Solid mango wood, hand-woven natural rattan cane front, dovetailed drawer box, brass knob.

products.title: Nilgiri Dining Table
products.description: A plank-top dining table in solid acacia with a visible butterfly key across the centre seam. The top is finished in hardwax oil, so a scratch can be spot-repaired instead of refinished.
products.materials: Solid acacia plank top with walnut butterfly keys, hardwax oil finish, solid ash trestle base.

products.title: Cane-Back Dining Chair
products.description: Stackable-adjacent but not stackable: a solid ash frame with a hand-caned back and an upholstered seat pad. Sold in sets because a dining table without chairs is a workbench.
products.materials: Solid ash frame, hand-woven rattan cane back, foam seat pad in cotton-linen weave.

products.title: Terracotta Sideboard
products.description: A long low sideboard in mango wood with terracotta-glazed ceramic door inlays. Deep enough for serveware, shallow enough not to eat the room. The last thing most dining rooms get.
products.materials: Solid mango wood carcass, terracotta-glazed ceramic inlay panels, adjustable interior shelving, brass hardware.

products.title: Handloom Cushion Cover Set
products.description: Handloom cotton covers with a concealed zip, cut slightly under-size so the insert stays plump. These are the piece people genuinely rotate — a set per season is normal, and they wear out.
products.materials: Handloom cotton, concealed nylon zip, pre-washed for shrinkage. Inserts sold separately.

products.title: Cotton Waffle Throw
products.description: A waffle-weave cotton throw that softens with every wash and is light enough for a Chennai summer. Sized to cover the arm of a three-seater rather than to be folded decoratively.
products.materials: 100% waffle-weave cotton, hand-knotted fringe, machine washable at 30°C.

products.title: Stoneware Vase Trio
products.description: Three wheel-thrown stoneware vases in graduated heights, glazed inside so they hold water. Sold as a trio because one vase on a sideboard reads as an accident.
products.materials: Wheel-thrown stoneware, food-safe interior glaze, unglazed foot ring.

products.title: Teak Care Polish
products.description: A beeswax and tung oil polish for solid-wood pieces, worked in with a cloth twice a year. Feeds the grain rather than sitting on top of it, so it will not go cloudy the way silicone sprays do.
products.materials: Beeswax, pure tung oil, orange terpene solvent, carnauba wax.

products.title: Fabric Guard & Upholstery Spray
products.description: A water-based repellent for upholstery and rugs. Re-apply after a deep clean or roughly twice a year; it beads spills long enough to get a cloth to them, which is the whole job.
products.materials: Water-based fluorine-free repellent polymer, no solvents, safe on cotton, linen and wool.
